decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Supreme Verdict and Field of Ruin to deal with threats, while Narset, Parter of Veils and Memory Deluge provide card advantage. The deck also includes various ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Deduce and Dovin's Veto. Additionally, cards like March of Otherworldly Light and The Wandering Emperor help to establish a strong board presence. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt opponents while setting up a powerful late-game engine with Yorion, Sky Nomad. It includes a mix of removal spells, card draw, and disruptive creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck also utilizes Yorion as a companion to provide extra value by flickering permanents for additional card advantage and disruption. With a mana base that can support both early game control and late game threats, the deck aims to grind out opponents with a combination of removal, disruption, and card advantage.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control spells and removal to disrupt and dismantle opponent's strategies. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Vanishing Verse to handle threats while setting up a win condition with cards like Stormchaser's Talent and This Town Ain't Big Enough. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for more versatility and flexibility in gameplay. The mana base is carefully built to ensure consistency and smooth mana curve, enabling the player to control the game and emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on efficiently ramping mana with Lotus Field and using various spells to search for combo pieces and protect the player. It aims to assemble a powerful board state that can generate a substantial advantage over the opponent quickly. The deck employs a mix of control elements, tutoring, and combo pieces to create a versatile and potent strategy that can adapt to different matchups and board states. By utilizing cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages, the deck can generate a significant amount of card advantage and mana acceleration to fuel its game-winning combos.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix for consistent damage. It includes a mix of cheap spells and card draw to enable the Phoenix's revival. It also includes disruptive elements like Brazen Borrower and Spell Pierce to control the board while maintaining pressure. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass as a finisher adds an element of surprise and versatility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around the powerful Arclight Phoenix.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans with a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It aims to control the board and card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Omen of the Sea, while using finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Thundertrap Trainer to close out the game. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck. The deck also utilizes lands that provide different effects to improve its overall strategy.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Soul-Scar Mage, Emberheart Challenger, and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to maintain board control and apply pressure to the opponent's life total. With a focus on efficient creatures and direct damage, the deck seeks to close out games before the opponent can stabilize or establish a strong defense. Additionally, the inclusion of colorless lands like Mutavault and utility lands like Den of the Bugbear provide additional flexibility and reach in the deck's game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying constant pressure on the opponent, utilizing efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat help to clear the way for attacks. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide additional creatures and card advantage, while Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can be a game-changer if left unchecked. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and maintain control throughout the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature play and disruption to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide strong threats, while Thoughtseize and Duress help to hinder the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to strip away opponent's resources while playing efficient threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester. Blightstep Pathway helps fix mana while Fatal Push and Go for the Throat provide removal options. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offers card advantage while Fear of Missing Out pressures opponents to make suboptimal plays. Mutavault provides additional threats, making this deck a dangerous force in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Narset, Parter of Veils, as well as removal spells Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It also utilizes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out games. With the ability to blink key permanents using Yorion, Sky Nomad, this deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can secure a win condition. The mana base is tuned to ensure consistent access to both colors of mana needed for its spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays and burn spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With a mix of cheap creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner and Soul-Scar Mage, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm, the deck aims to apply pressure early and finish off opponents with direct damage. Key cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off help increase damage output, while lands like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provide additional reach. The deck aims to win decisively and efficiently in the early game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on maintaining board control through a combination of removal spells and counterspells while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value with its flickering effect. The win condition of the deck is to outvalue the opponent with powerful finishers like Oildeep Gearhulk and Hopeless Nightmare, while also being able to recycle key spells with cards like Deadly Cover-Up and Momentum Breaker.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with aggressive creatures and using burn spells to control the pace of the game. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while also utilizing efficient removal like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way for your creatures to deal damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and direct damage spells to finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also utilizing Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Invasion of Ixalan to generate additional mana. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Ulvenwald Oddity while also generating card advantage through Storm the Festival. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect against counterspells, making it difficult for the opponent to disrupt the deck's game plan.

This artifact aggro deck focuses on quickly turning artifacts into creatures and using them to deal damage to the opponent. By combining cards like Ensoul Artifact and Legion Extruder with powerful artifact creatures like Smuggler's Copter, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression. Cards like Spyglass Siren and Gastal Thrillroller help to disrupt the opponent's strategies while burn spells like Torch the Tower and Shrapnel Blast provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck's mana base is designed to support its low curve and aggressive game plan.
